To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the passive and active methods of condensation heat enhancement are effective and can be used for the enhancement of the condensation heat transfer coefficient by 1.2-1.4 times.
the condensation heat transfer can be enhanced by the application of passive (strip) and active (EHD) methods of condensate removal.

the condensation heat transfer enhancement by means of the passive and active condensation drainage methods is possible and can be achieved by using the drainage strips and EHD technique, respectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the experimental investigation of the heat transfer and pressure drop characteristics for the condensation of R134a in a horizontal tube with the condensate removal strip and in the presence of the electrohydrodynamic effect.
the enhancement of condensation process in microchannels.
the development of the new methods of condensate heat transfer enhancement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
both passive and active techniques are very promising and can be applied in practice.
the condensate removal techniques are very effective in the case of low heat transfer rates and low condensate loads.

the condensate removal techniques can be used for heat transfer augmentation in a condenser, however the effect of the condensates removal is not as high as the one obtained for the heat transfer augmentation by means of the surface roughness techniques.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the passive and active techniques of heat transfer enhancement are very promising and should be developed further.
the application of the passive and active methods of condensation heat enhancement may lead to significant heat transfer augmentation.
the condensate removal techniques are very effective and they can be successfully applied to the condensers of different design and size.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the condensation heat transfer can be enhanced significantly by using the passive and active methods of condensate enhancement.
both methods are able to enhance the condensate removal and therefore the heat transfer coefficient.
both methods of condensation heat augmentation can significantly enhance condensation heat transfer and are very promising for industrial application.
